orders_by_status.map: function (doc) { if (doc.type === 'order' && typeof doc.status === 'string' && doc.totals && typeof doc.totals.grand_total === 'number') { emit(doc.status, doc.totals.grand_total); } }

orders_by_month.map: function (doc) { if (doc.type === 'order' && typeof doc.ordered_at === 'string' && doc.totals && typeof doc.totals.grand_total === 'number') { emit(doc.ordered_at.substring(0, 7), doc.totals.grand_total); } }
